Monologue: What interesting times we are living in, friend.
Chaos is erupting around us, but here you are, still cooking.
Are you aware of what you are missing? What you could have done?
Those around you could have been saved, but you chose not to.
Their fates are the result of your apathy.
But that's okay, friend. I could not care less what you have chosen. That in itself, is a choice I could record.
You see, friend, I am here to learn more about this city on behalf of my…superiors. The Spoilage here is something they are greatly interested in.
I watch, just like you, of all the folks who live and breathe in this city. When I act, it is to *experiment*.
You, my friend, are my final subject. Unfortunately, you proved to be less interesting than I initially thought.
You can return to your work in peace. This is our final goodbye, friend. There's not much left. I hope you enjoy the ride of what's left.
